g.text: | **Google Spanner** | **PC/EC** | Prioritizes **strong consistency** even during normal operation. It waits for global replication before confirming writes. |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | **Apache Cassandra** | **PA/EL** | Prioritizes **availability and low latency**. Writes return quickly and replicas sync later. |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | **Amazon DynamoDB** | **PA/EL** | Designed for high availability and low latency at massive scale. Eventual consistency is common. |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | **MongoDB (majority write concern)** | **PC/EC** | Waits for majority replica confirmation, so latency increases but consistency improves. |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: | **Apache CouchDB** | **PA/EL** | Focuses on availability and offline-friendly replication, so eventual consistency is used. |

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
